notes.title: Demo Update for Apr 05 (DEMOV.050425)
notes.content:
Hello! This is yet another update that addresses some issues. Here's what has changed:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where throwing an Escape Hex would always throw the whole stack
[*] Fixed an issue where the visual effect of the Escape Hex would stay visible
[*] Using an Escape Hex to swap positions with an enemy will now interrupt special attacks
[*] Fixed an issue where "Foul" enemies would not grant the correct amount of EXP
[*] Increased maximum inventory upgrades to 39 entries (full 3 pages)
[*] Fixed an issue where the message telling you that you can't upgrade your inventory any further wouldn't fit into the text box
[*] Increased item drop chance of "Foul" bosses 
[*] Item names will now have the same color in the message log as they have in the inventory
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Demo Update for Apr 02 (DEMOV.020425)
notes.content:
Hello! This is another small update that addresses some issues. Here's what has changed:

[list]
[*] Added the ability to skip a turn (check controls)
[*] Fixed an issue where the first person camera mode could be used to skip turns
[*] Reduced throw damage of armor items slightly
[*] The game now saves on player death instead of after the run result screen
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Demo Update for Mar 19 (DEMOV.190325)
notes.content:
Hello! Here's another demo update, bringing some more bug fixes and adjustments. Here is what has changed:

[list]
[*] Using spell books and elixirs won't cost a turn anymore
[*] Fixed an issue where you could dodge the "End run" damage
[*] Fixed an issue where you could get status effects like bleed even when dodging the attack
[*] Fixed a rendering issue on older / integrated GPUs
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Demo Update for Feb 26 (DEMOV.260225)
notes.content:
Hello! Here's another demo update, this time focusing again on some general bug fixes, adjustments and balancing tweaks. Here is what has changed:

[list]
[*] Using a "Vitality" elixir when at full health will keep your health at max now
[*] The vendor will now always sell a box item
[*] Adjusted the damage calculation of the "Whirlwind" spell some more
[*] Changed the text of the "Quit" menu entry to "Save & Exit", so that it indicates that the game is saved before exiting
[*] The first boss now commits to its special attacks, making it more clear where you can stand without taking damage
[*] Trying to level up an already leveled up monster now prints an info message stating that it can't level up any more
[*] Fixed an issue where Hounds would not always target you with their special attack when you're invisible
[*] Fixed an issue where poison could trigger the "Bloated" trait
[*] Fixed an issue where poison could be dodged
[*] Fixed an issue where the "Poison" serum would print the "You're poisoned" message twice
[*] Fixed an issue where the "Change" hex could change enemies to same enemy type they already were
[*] Fixed an issue where a spellbook would not be used up when learning the max rank of a spell
[*] Fixed an issue where warping an enemy would not stop their special attacks
[/list]



Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Demo Update for Feb 18 (DEMOV.180225)
notes.content:
Hello! This is the first update since releasing the demo on Steam! This first round of adjustments is meant to mostly tweak balancing stuff but there will be a couple of surprises as well. Here is what has changed:

[list]
[*] Added a new dialog scene with the vendor after dying
[*] You can now talk to the vendor to get some tips and tricks. Nihihihi!
[*] Increased damage of ranged weapons
[*] Increased the base damage of the spell "Whirlwind"
[*] Special attacks of enemies are now telegraphed by an indicator on the floor tiles, which should make it a bit easier to avoid them
[*] Being confused doesn't prevent the usage of items anymore
[*] Reduced the chance of enemies hunting down the player
[*] Reduced the attack speed of Zombies to two turns per attack
[*] Added a chance for standard Zombies to become severed on death
[*] Added a chance to dodge attacks even without having the "Evasive" trait, the "Evasive" trait now increases the chance to dodge an attack
[*] Elixirs now only increase attributes for the current run instead of permanently
[*] The cursor that is shown when pressing the "Look" button now indicates the range of the equipped gun
[*] Trying to use the "Examine" option without standing on an item now shows an info message
[*] Lowered the chance for Monster Houses to appear slightly
[*] Fixed an issue where costs for permanent upgrades would not increase correctly
[*] Fixed an issue where Sentinels would not awaken when encountered in a Monster House
[/list]

Thanks for playing!
